scope: one-shot named offline operator snapshot inventory CLI

checks.name: CLI, inventory, envelope, descriptor, snapshot, and source-index focused tests
checks.command: python3 -m unittest house.relay.tests.test_cli house.relay.tests.test_snapshot_inventory house.relay.tests.test_snapshot_envelope house.relay.tests.test_snapshot_descriptor house.relay.tests.test_operator_snapshot house.relay.tests.test_preview_index house.relay.tests.test_task_card_index

checks.name: all component House test suites
checks.command: for test_dir in $(find house -type d -name tests -print | sort); do python3 -m unittest discover -s "$test_dir" -p 'test_*.py'; done

checks.name: static checks
checks.command: python3 -m compileall -q house/relay && ruff check changed files && ruff format --check changed files && git diff --check

claim_ceiling: A one-shot local command that loads one caller-named JSON list and prints a read-only inventory over immutable local snapshot envelopes. It does not select a default input, scan storage, create/retry/repair/delete data, apply retention, discover or refresh sources, open a relay database, read live task/relay state, bind a listener, start a viewer, launch a browser, call iTerm, accept terminal input beyond the named JSON file, create/mutate/dispatch tasks, contact workers/providers, grant authority, or open a reverse channel.
